output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, thus causing a denial of service to the user.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; statement can overflow if _value is of a large enough value, causing it to wrap around and become a low value, allowing attackers to make balances become negative, causing a denial of service to the user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; statement can overflow if _value is of a large enough value, causing it to wrap around and become a low value, allowing attackers to make balances become negative, causing a denial of service to the user.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount variable is set to msg.value * buyRate; If buyRate is set to a very large value, attackers can overflow the amount variable, causing it to wrap around and become a low value, allowing attackers to buy an arbitrary large amount of tokens owned by the contract, causing a denial of service to the user.
